The paragraph describes a bank implementing background checks on new employees in accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA). This action is compliant with legal standards, as the FCRA regulates the collection, dissemination, and use of consumer credit information, including the requirements for obtaining consumer reports (such as background checks) for employment purposes. The bank's policy of ensuring employees meet FCRA standards demonstrates adherence to federal regulations.
